verses.1: I am the true Ambelos. My father is a farmer.
verses.2: Any seed that doesn’t bear fruit within me, it will be rejected by it. And any seed that does bear fruit, it will be utilized by it so that more fruit can be produced.
verses.3: You are already pure, because of the words I have spoken to you.
verses.4: Stay with me; I will also stay with you. Just as a vine cannot bear fruit without being planted in soil, so too, you cannot bear fruit unless you remain with me.
verses.5: I am the “ambelos”; you are the ones who make requests of me. Those who stay with me, I believe, will bear a great burden in themselves. It’s because without me, they wouldn’t be able to do anything at all.
verses.6: If no one is there to take care of me, then it will be left outside as a pile of ashes. They will gather them all together and throw them into the fire. Then they will burn them.
verses.7: If you remain with me, and if my words also remain with you, then if you desire, you may request them for yourself.
verses.8: In this, my father was honored to have you bring forth a great fruit, and to become my disciples.
verses.9: As my father loved me, so I have loved you. Please remain in my love.
verses.10: If you obey my commands, then you will be loved by me. Just as I obeyed the commands of my father, so also should you obey my commands. I love you deeply.
verses.11: I have said these things to you, so that my joy may be in you, and your joy may be fulfilled.
verses.12: This is the command I give you: to love one another, just as I have loved you.
verses.13: No one else has this kind of love, so that someone can sacrifice their soul for their friends.
verses.14: You are my friends if you do what I have asked of you.
verses.15: I no longer call you slaves, because a slave doesn’t know what his master wants him to do. But I have called you friends, for everything I heard from my Father, I have shared with you.
verses.16: You did not elect me, but I was elected by you. I placed you in a position where you could carry forward the message and its benefits. This way, whatever you ask of your father, he can do it through me.
verses.17: I have done this for your sake, so that you may love each other.
verses.18: If the world hates you, then know that it first hated me first.
verses.19: If one were from this world, then the world would surely care about that person. But since one isn’t from this world, and I’ve chosen you from this world, then the world hates you because of this.
verses.20: Remember the words I said to you. There is no slave who is more loyal to his master than me. If they persecute me, they will also persecute you. If they reject my words, they will also reject your words.
verses.21: But all these things they will do to you because of my name. They don’t know who sent me.
verses.22: If we hadn’t come and spoken to them, they wouldn’t have committed any sin. But now, they have no reason to discuss their sins anymore.
verses.23: He hates me, and he also hates my father.
verses.24: If I hadn’t done those tasks in them, which no one else did, then they wouldn’t have been considered a sin. But now, even the smallest actions can be considered sins, just like those that I and my father committed.
verses.25: But so that the law, which is written in their laws, can be fulfilled: that they should give me freely.
verses.26: When the messenger I sent to you from the Father comes, then the spirit of truth that comes from the Father will testify about me.
verses.27: And you also testify that they have been with me from the beginning.
